instruction: Put the blue pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
go_home()
obs = observe()
candidates = grasp_candidates("blue_pen")
candidate = next(c for c in candidates if abs(c["yaw"] - obs["objects"]["blue_pen"]["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1)
grasp(candidate)
spots = free_spots("green_case", "blue_pen")
spot = next(s for s in spots["spots"] if abs(s["object_long_axis_yaw"] - obs["objects"]["blue_pen"]["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1)
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["object_long_axis_yaw"] + (candidate["yaw"] - obs["objects"]["blue_pen"]["long_axis_yaw"]))
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("blue_pen", "green_case")
